((is_active = true) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM products p
  WHERE ((p.id = customization_options.product_id) AND (p.is_active = true)))))

policies.name: product_components_public_select
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM products p
  WHERE ((p.id = product_components.parent_product_id) AND (p.is_active = true))))

policies.name: product_images_public_select
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM products p
  WHERE ((p.id = product_images.product_id) AND (p.is_active = true))))

policies.name: recommendations_public_read
policies.using:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM products p
  WHERE ((p.id = product_recommendations.product_id) AND p.is_active))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM products p
  WHERE ((p.id = product_recommendations.recommended_product_id) AND p.is_active AND p.is_available AND (NOT p.is_sold_out)))))

triggers.name: trg_audit_products
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_products AFTER UPDATE ON public.products FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.name IS DISTINCT FROM new.name) OR (old.description IS DISTINCT FROM new.description) OR (old.price IS DISTINCT FROM new.price) OR (old.category_id IS DISTINCT FROM new.category_id) OR (old.occasion IS DISTINCT FROM new.occasion) OR (old.season_id IS DISTINCT FROM new.season_id) OR (old.is_featured IS DISTINCT FROM new.is_featured) OR (old.is_available IS DISTINCT FROM new.is_available) OR (old.is_sold_out IS DISTINCT FROM new.is_sold_out) OR (old.catalog_order IS DISTINCT FROM new.catalog_order) OR (old.is_active IS DISTINCT FROM new.is_active))) EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_products_change()
